description: Relive the classic era of Minecraft PE on your Windows device! Version 0.15.0 (The Friendly Update) brings realms support, horses, lead, name tags, stray and husk mobs, pig riding, and new jungle temples. Features: - Full support for touch, keyboard & mouse, and Xbox controllers. - Smooth performance optimized for legacy Windows 8/8.1 systems. - Classic 0.15.0 gameplay with original UI, mobs, and structures. - Offline play supported without mandatory store account updates. Credits to Mojang / Microsoft Studios. Uploaded for archival and preservation purposes.
